title: US Stock Market Movers & Screener Input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: movers = top gainers, losers, and most-active stocks. screener = filter the whole US market by your criteria.

count.title: Count per list (movers mode)
count.description: How many stocks per mover list (gainers/losers/most-active).

minPrice.title: Min price (USD)
minPrice.description: Skip stocks priced below this. Movers default to a $1 floor so lists are real liquid stocks, not penny pumps.

maxPrice.title: Max price (USD, screener)
maxPrice.description: Skip stocks priced above this. 0 = no maximum.

minMarketCap.title: Min market cap (USD, screener)
minMarketCap.description: Skip stocks below this market cap, e.g. 1000000000 for $1B+. 0 = no minimum.

maxMarketCap.title: Max market cap (USD, screener)
maxMarketCap.description: Skip stocks above this market cap. 0 = no maximum.

minPctChange.title: Min percent change (screener)
minPctChange.description: Keep only stocks up at least this percent today, e.g. 5 for +5% and up. 0 = no filter.

minVolume.title: Min volume
minVolume.description: Skip stocks with volume below this. Movers default to 50,000 for liquidity.

sector.title: Sector (screener)
sector.description: Keep only stocks in a sector, e.g. Technology, Health Care, Energy, Finance. Empty = all sectors.

country.title: Country (screener)
country.description: Keep only stocks from a country, e.g. United States, China. Empty = all.

maxRows.title: Max rows (screener)
maxRows.description: Cap on screener rows returned. Controls total cost.
